Package net.ygbstudio.jbrave.core.model

Enum Class BraveErrorCode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BraveErrorCode>
net.ygbstudio.jbrave.core.model.BraveErrorCode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<BraveErrorCode>, Constable
public enum BraveErrorCode extends Enum<BraveErrorCode>
Enumeration of Brave API error codes.

This enum represents the different error codes that the Brave API can return.

Author:
Yoham Gabriel @ YGB Studio
